articles.title: Show HN: reverse-engineer secure-enclave fingerprint scanner to work on Linux
articles.summary: This article discusses the operational mechanisms of a Goodix SPI fingerprint sensor, differentiating it from common USB laptop sensors. It explores the two methods of driving the sensor, including a 'traditional' approach involving the Rich Execution Environment (REE) and the operating system's kernel. The technical analysis delves into the intricate software-hardware interaction crucial for secure and efficient biometric authentication in modern devices.

articles.title: "Scotland is powering Britain's future defence" says Defence Secretary on first visit to Rosyth Shipyard and forces housing
articles.summary: The UK Defence Secretary made his inaugural visit to Scotland, touring Babcock's Rosyth facility, a crucial naval shipbuilding site, notably for Type 26 frigates. He also inspected Service Family Accommodation in Edinburgh. This visit underscored the government's commitment to bolstering the defence industry, supporting regional prosperity, and prioritizing the welfare of service personnel and their families.

articles.title: 36th Meeting of the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination on India-China Border Affairs (August 06, 2026)
articles.summary: India and China held their 36th Working Mechanism for Consultation & Coordination on Border Affairs (WMCC) meeting on August 6th. This crucial diplomatic forum aims to manage border issues and maintain peace along the LAC. SSB aspirants should understand such engagements are vital to India's national security strategy, demonstrating proactive efforts in safeguarding territorial integrity.

articles.title: PH, Australia defense chiefs condemn Chinese hostile actions in SCS
articles.summary: The Philippines and Australia have jointly expressed serious concerns over China's "destabilizing and dangerous conduct" by its vessels, likely referring to maritime activities in the South China Sea. This collaboration underscores growing regional solidarity in addressing Beijing's assertive posture and maintaining stability in vital strategic waters, signalling increased diplomatic pressure from Manila and Canberra.

articles.title: NEET UG counselling 2026: MCC opens round 1 choice filling window; candidates can submit preferences till August 13
articles.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has commenced Round 1 choice filling for NEET UG counselling 2026. Aspirants aiming for medical and dental college admissions must submit their preferences by August 13. This crucial phase allows candidates to select their desired institutions and courses, marking a significant step in their journey to becoming medical professionals across the nation.

articles.title: Students’ Group Threatens SKMU Lockdown Over Reduced UG Seats in Dumka College
articles.summary: A significant 'terror plot' controversy at Jantar Mantar has resulted in the transfer of Amritsar's senior police officer, Gurpreet Bhullar. This development has elicited strong criticism from the BJP, raising questions about national security protocols and police accountability. Aspirants should observe the interplay of domestic politics and law enforcement in such critical national events.

articles.title: Mixed cropping emerges as a safer bet
articles.summary: A major controversy has emerged concerning a 'terror plot' allegedly linked to Jantar Mantar. Following these developments, Amritsar's top police official, Gurpreet Bhullar, has been shunted from his position. The opposition BJP has reacted strongly, criticizing the handling of the situation and the administrative action, indicating significant political and law-and-order ramifications within the country.

articles.title: Indian Air Force showcases the Rafale
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force's (IAF) Rafale fleet recently achieved a historic milestone by debuting at Exercise Pitch Black in Australia. This marks the first participation of the IAF's advanced multirole fighters in the major international air combat exercise, demonstrating India's evolving air power capabilities and commitment to interoperability with global partners, a key aspect for SSB aspirants to understand regarding defence diplomacy.
